comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body: It's the best ship for anyone who doesn't want to go into melee/deck, generally those are non-pirate players. Beyond that i don't see how it's in any way the ship that 'rules the seas'. FATS vs melee ship (eg. MLA/FLR etc), FATS has advantage. But in a battle with another maritimer whose strength is fighting from range too? That's the beauty of the game for me, as is any game that has a successful game philosophy to it, no particular type of ship really stands out as 'invincible'. It wasn't always like this cause deck battling disrupted the balance for a long while but turtle ships and eventually, deck battle choice in 2nd age will bring the balance back i think. Price-wise, whatever... it's a matter of what people want to pay, if there's buyers offering 30b then go ahead and sell them at that price. NC ships trade in a free market and that's how it works. U want a fixed price tag that isn't swayed by demand? Go to shipyard master.
